class.name: CgameDesktopPlatformBackend
class.brief_description: Filesystem platform backend for desktop systems.
class.description: [CgameDesktopPlatformBackend] stores saves as files below [member root]. A save slot consists of [code]slot.sav[/code] (main), [code]slot.tmp[/code] (write in progress) and [code]slot.bak[/code] (previous main file). Writes are atomic: the data goes to the temporary file first, is verified by size, and only then replaces the main file after the old one was moved to the backup name. Achievements are kept in [code]achievements.json[/code] below the root. A single local user is signed in and paired with controller device [code]0[/code].

method.name: corrupt_main
method.description: Test helper. Overwrites the main file of [param slot] with garbage to simulate a torn write or a disk fault.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a backend that stores its files below [param root] and creates the directory.

members.member: Directory below which all files are stored. Setting it creates the directory.
